description: Quantify the Phenix ksdssp helix annotations by length, hydrophobicity and pLDDT, and re-examine the positive-inside statistics for ftm3
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/21a3a723-58c5-4fca-8ed8-e8c861fa5e39/provenance/"

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
three={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
       'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
       'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}

def read_af(path):
    seq={}; plddt={}; ca={}
    for ln in open(path):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            i=int(ln[22:26]); seq[i]=three.get(ln[17:20].strip(),"X")
            plddt[i]=float(ln[60:66]); ca[i]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    return seq,plddt,ca

# ksdssp helices returned by phenix.secondary_structure_restraints this iteration
HEL={"P0CU06":[(2,18),(26,28),(38,61),(67,83),(85,91),(94,123),(135,137)],
     "Q9P3E6":[(2,22),(49,51),(76,78),(85,87),(90,120),(127,154),(158,189),(197,221),
               (224,235),(237,257),(262,291),(293,295),(298,313),(315,321),(325,341)]}
NAME={"P0CU06":"ftm3 (146 aa)","Q9P3E6":"SPAC750.05c (344 aa)"}
# Phobius TM segments from iteration 2
PTM={"P0CU06":[(38,59)],"Q9P3E6":[(95,116),(128,145),(177,193),(200,220),(232,250),(271,288),(300,322)]}

rows=[]
store={}
for acc in ["P0CU06","Q9P3E6"]:
    seq,plddt,ca=read_af(P+f"AF-{acc}-F1.pdb"); store[acc]=(seq,plddt,ca)
    for (s,e) in HEL[acc]:
        res=[seq[i] for i in range(s,e+1)]
        L=e-s+1; mkd=np.mean([KD[r] for r in res]); mpl=np.mean([plddt[i] for i in range(s,e+1)])
        # end-to-end span of the helix in Angstrom (a 20-residue TM helix spans ~30 A)
        span=float(np.linalg.norm(ca[e]-ca[s]))
        overlap=any(min(e,b)-max(s,a)+1 >= 10 for a,b in PTM[acc])
        rows.append(dict(acc=acc,gene=NAME[acc],helix=f"{s}-{e}",length=L,
                         mean_KD=round(mkd,2),mean_pLDDT=round(mpl,1),
                         end_to_end_A=round(span,1),
                         membrane_competent=bool(L>=17 and mkd>0.5),
                         overlaps_Phobius_TM=overlap))
h=pd.DataFrame(rows); h.to_csv(P+"table7_alphafold_helix_inventory.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",200)
print(h.to_string(index=False))
print("\nmembrane-competent helices (len>=17 and mean KD>+0.5):")
print(h.groupby("gene").membrane_competent.sum())
print("\nagreement with Phobius TM segments:")
print(h[h.membrane_competent].groupby("gene").overlaps_Phobius_TM.agg(["sum","size"]))

# ---- net-charge orientation check for ftm3, done honestly both ways ----
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0CU06.fasta",timeout=60)
s="".join(l.strip() for l in r.text.splitlines() if not l.startswith(">"))
N,C=s[0:37],s[59:146]
def q(x): return sum(c in "KR" for c in x)-sum(c in "DE" for c in x)
flN,flC=s[22:37],s[59:74]
print("\n--- positive-inside statistics for ftm3, three ways ---")
print(f"15-residue flanks        : N-flank K+R={sum(c in 'KR' for c in flN)}  C-flank K+R={sum(c in 'KR' for c in flC)}  -> tied")
print(f"whole-domain net charge  : N(1-37)={q(N):+d}   C(60-146)={q(C):+d}   -> favours C-side inside (contradicts Phobius)")
print(f"net charge per 100 aa    : N={100*q(N)/len(N):+.1f}  C={100*q(C)/len(C):+.1f}  -> favours N-side inside (agrees with Phobius)")

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.6))
for ax,acc in zip(axes,["P0CU06","Q9P3E6"]):
    seq,plddt,ca=store[acc]; n=max(seq)
    xs=np.arange(1,n+1)
    kd=np.array([np.mean([KD[seq[j]] for j in range(max(1,i-9),min(n,i+9)+1)]) for i in xs])
    ax.axhline(0,color="#999",lw=0.6); ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c0392b",ls=":",lw=1)
    ax.plot(xs,kd,color="#333",lw=1.1,label="Kyte-Doolittle, w=19")
    for (a,b) in PTM[acc]:
        ax.axvspan(a,b,color="#e07b39",alpha=0.30)
    sub=h[h.acc==acc]
    for _,rw in sub.iterrows():
        a,b=map(int,rw.helix.split("-"))
        col="#2e7d32" if rw.membrane_competent else "#9aa5ad"
        ax.plot([a,b],[-4.3,-4.3],lw=7,color=col,solid_capstyle="butt")
    ax.set_xlim(0,n+1); ax.set_ylim(-4.8,3.0)
    ax.set_ylabel("hydropathy")
    ax.set_title(f"{NAME[acc]}: {int(sub.membrane_competent.sum())} of {len(sub)} AlphaFold helices are membrane-competent "
                 f"(length 17 or more and mean KD above +0.5)",fontsize=10)
axes[1].set_xlabel("residue")
axes[0].plot([],[],lw=7,color="#2e7d32",label="AlphaFold helix, membrane-competent")
axes[0].plot([],[],lw=7,color="#9aa5ad",label="AlphaFold helix, not membrane-competent")
axes[0].axvspan(0,0,color="#e07b39",alpha=0.30,label="Phobius TM segment")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper right",ncol=2)
fig.suptitle("Phenix ksdssp helix inventory of the AlphaFold models: ftm3 has one membrane-competent helix, the 344 aa PF09437 member has six",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.94])
plt.show()
